title: The website editor keeps Publish on a phone screen, and its small print reads by day

source.ref: Child of LIVE-EDITOR-SHELL; two of the faults LIVE-2309 found and left open (2026-11-23).

detail:
Split from LIVE-EDITOR-SHELL on 2026-11-23. PREMISE RE-TESTED FIRST in Chromium on the real shell (the LIVE-2309 harness, with one correction: it loaded the alias sheet before core.css, the reverse of app/layout.tsx, so equal-weight lifts such as the cooler pastel lost; fixed here, and every number below is from the corrected order).

(a) PUBLISH ON A PHONE. Confirmed, and wider than reported. With the inspector open at 320, 360, 375 and 390 the toolbar was 400px wide and Publish ended at 394. The cause is the grid, not the bar: the rails are overlays on a phone, but the generated kit's fold rules outrank its own phone grid, so a folded rail kept a 60px column and an open inspector a 340px one. The same fault left a dead 60px strip beside the canvas when both rails were shut, and because an open rail is fixed and leaves the grid, the canvas slid into the rail's column and re-laid the Site out at 126px behind it. After a publish the bar also carries View live site (LIVE-2321), and no phone row holds both: Publish ended at 404 on every phone width, in every fold state, and the page picker shrank to 3px. And the open left rail on a phone drew five icons and no panel: the kit hides the body under 1100px and only the 821 to 1100 band undid it.

(b) DAY SMALL PRINT. Confirmed: 8 pairs under 4.5:1 by day. Placeholders took the reset default, half the field's ink (2.40 to 2.88:1). The Header and Footer rows are drawn at 85%, which took their detail and count to 3.88 (3.65 hovered). Two pairs LIVE-2309 listed (the change count on Publish at 4.1, a field count on a lit row at 4.4) were artefacts of the wrong sheet order and pass in the app's order; nothing was changed for them. The corrected order also showed one night pair LIVE-2309 missed: the chosen row's detail and count at 4.05 on the pastel wash.

WHAT CHANGED, all in app/themes/frequency/editor-shell.css, shared tokens only, no literal colour, no markup. Under 820px the grid is restated for every fold as no rail columns, the canvas is named into the middle column, and the open rail gets its tabs and panel back. Under the shared 600px step View live site takes its own full-width row under the bar and the overlays start beneath it. At night an open overlay on a phone is the solid raised surface, because the canvas now stays under it and a light Site behind 72% glass lifted the ground. Placeholders read the muted ink by day and at night. The Header and Footer rows' detail and count read the body ink. The chosen row's detail and count read the body ink at night.

MEASURED AFTER, same walk. Publish inside the toolbar and clickable in all 76 measured states (11 widths from 320 to 1280, touch and mouse, inspector open and shut, before and after a publish, by day and at night; 30 of them were outside before). 0 pairs under the bar by day and 0 at night across 25 states each, which now include the templates sheet, the versions drawer, the schedule form, the Share toast and Pick your look at 1440 and 390.

THE CANVAS. At 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 the canvas is pixel-identical by day and at night; inside the stage rectangle the only pixels that move are Vera's placeholder line by day. On a phone the canvas frame is deliberately not identical: it is 390px wide in every state, where it was 330 beside a dead strip, 126 behind the open rail and 0 behind the open inspector. The Site's own styles are untouched and no rule names anything inside the frame.

(c) THE SHEETS AT NIGHT. Looked at and measured, nothing to fix: Share is a toast in this editor, versions are a drawer inside the publish dialog, and with the templates sheet and Pick your look all four read at night with no pair under the bar.

VERIFIED: the probe fails on main (45 findings) and passes here; LIVE-2308, LIVE-2309, LIVE-2321 and BLD-002 pass unedited; before and after pictures at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000, light and dark, plus the state walk at 1440 and the phone after a publish, in the project files under editor/shell-390. NOT VERIFIED: the authenticated route on a deploy; Safari and Firefox (only Chromium is installed here); a real phone (Chromium's phone emulation only); the 600 to 820 band after a publish beyond the toolbar measurement.

FOUND, NOT FIXED: every dialog carries the kit's 140px pastel band with a hard lower edge that crosses the first field when the heading is short, by day and at night; Pick your look on a phone lets its theme list run to the sheet's rounded bottom edge; the LIVE-2309 probe resolves night tokens without the alias sheet's later equal-weight lifts, which is how the chosen row passed there.

verify.note: Fails on main: on a phone the grid keeps rail columns (400px of them on a 390px screen with the inspector open), the row cannot hold View live site and Publish, the open rail hides its panel, and by day placeholders (2.4 to 2.9:1) and the Header and Footer rows' detail (3.9:1) sit under the bar, as does the chosen row's detail at night. Passes once the resolved cascade gives a phone no rail columns, a toolbar row that fits 320, 360 and 390 before and after a publish, an open rail with its panel, and 4.5:1 or better for every measured small-print pair by day and at night, from shared tokens only.
